name: Vortex of Shadow
body:
School conjuration [shadow]; Level death mage 7, sorcerer/wizard 7, summoner 6, unchained summoner 6

CAST

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level.

Effect shadowy whirlwind
Duration 1 round, see text
Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a violent whirlwind of shadowy material. It occupies the space of a huge creature and on the turn it is summoned, it can move 60 feet in a straight line. Any creature that is in the space of the whirlwind when it is summoned or anywhere along its movement must make two saving throws.

First, the target must make a Fortitude save or take 1d6 cold damage per caster level (maximum 15d6). A successful saving throw halves this damage.

Second, the target must make a Reflex save or be thrown 1d4 x 10 feet in a random direction, taking 1d6 damage per 10 feet traveled. If the save is failed by 10 or more, they are also prone. A successful Reflex save moves the creature 5 feet in a random direction and no damage is taken.
